patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was involved in a head-on collision as the front seat, unrestrained driver. Following the event, the patient complains of chest pain. No past significant medical history. The patient was given 2 liters of Ringer lactate solution and morphine for management.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No known drug allergies. No previous surgeries or significant medical conditions.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Occasional alcohol use, denies tobacco or illicit drug use. Works as a computer programmer.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Complains of pain in the chest area, denies headache, dizziness, shortness of breath, or abdominal pain.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient who presents with chest pain following a motor vehicle collision.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I’m a 27-year-old male, and I was in a head-on collision as an unrestrained front-seat driver. Since then I’ve had chest pain, and there’s bruising over my chest wall. I was given Ringer lactate and morphine when I came in.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that look scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any scratched or rubbed-raw skin or small open spots—just the bruising over my chest wall.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or you have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you stop, or you wake up gasping)?
turns.patient_answer: “Not that I know of—no one has mentioned any pauses in my breathing during sleep, and I haven’t woken up gasping or had any trouble breathing at night.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—such as severe pain, obvious swelling or bruising, deformity, or trouble using the area normally? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t notice deformity, severe swelling, or trouble using my arms or moving normally—I mostly just have the chest pain and bruising over the chest wall.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No—nothing like redness or warmth on my left wrist that looks different from the other side. I’ve mainly just had chest pain and bruising over my chest wall since the collision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any increase in urination—no more frequent trips to the bathroom and no larger volume than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “Occasional alcohol use, but I don’t smoke or use any illicit drugs. I haven’t taken any stimulants or other substances, and other than the morphine I was given in the clinic, I haven’t used opioids.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking urine or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine—no leaking and no accidents, and I’m able to make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin lesion—such as a new spot, sore, bump, mole change, or area that won’t heal? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin lesions—no new spots, sores, bumps, or areas that won’t heal, just the bruising over my chest wall.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any nosebleeds or any blood coming from my nose since the collision.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk—no new spots or rash over my chest, back, or belly, just the bruising over my chest wall.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any swollen, twisted, or bulging veins in your legs (varicose veins), especially around the calves or thighs?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any swollen or bulging veins in my legs, and I don’t have any calf or thigh swelling or twisted veins.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever been diagnosed with eczema, or have you had recurring itchy, dry, or inflamed skin patches? (Yes or No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’ve never been diagnosed with eczema, and I haven’t had recurring itchy, dry, or inflamed skin patches—just the bruising over my chest wall since the collision.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. Have you had diarrhea that looks bloody or has red/maroon blood in it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any diarrhea, and I haven’t seen any blood or maroon/red-looking stool since the collision.”
